SELECT count(*) FROM SpanEvent WHERE spanKind = 
\server' TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 2 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM SpanEvent WHERE spanKind = \server' TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 2 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE status = \error') FROM SpanEvent WHERE spanKind = \server' TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 2 hours ago
SELECT histogram(duration, 10, 100) FROM SpanEvent WHERE spanKind = \server' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT average(duration) FROM SpanEvent FACET serviceName SINCE 1 hour ago

SELECT * FROM SpanEvent WHERE traceId = \SELECT
traceId
FROM
SpanEvent
ORDER
BY
timestamp
DESC
LIMIT
1' ORDER BY startTime
SELECT operationName, average(duration), count(*) FROM SpanEvent WHERE spanKind = \server' SINCE 1 hour ago ORDER BY average(duration) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT operationName, count(*) FROM SpanEvent WHERE status = \error' SINCE 1 hour ago ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT operationName, average(duration), count(*) FROM SpanEvent WHERE component = \database' SINCE 1 hour ago ORDER BY average(duration) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT operationName, average(duration), count(*) FROM SpanEvent WHERE component = \http' SINCE 1 hour ago ORDER BY average(duration) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT average(value) FROM MetricEvent FACET metricName TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 2 hours ago
